units.source_text: 秀男身强力壮，有才能，对工作也很热心。

en.t: Hideo was strong and sturdy, talented, and very enthusiastic about his work.

units.source_text: 不过长年累月坐在高机的窄板上不停地织，恐怕屁股上都长茧子了。

en.t: But after sitting for years on the narrow board of the tall loom, weaving without pause, he had probably developed calluses on his backside.
